extension.description: View, annotate and translate PDF files inside VS Code — dark mode, page-color inversion and AI translation.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Opening PDFs requires local file system access.
command.goToOutlineEntry.title: Go to Outline Entry
command.goToPage.title: Go to Page…
view.outline.name: PDF Outline
config.default.cursor.description: The default cursor tool for preview.
config.default.scale.description: The default zoom level for preview. Allowed values are `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, and 1-based scale values. (`1.0` means 100%)
config.default.scrollMode.description: The default scroll mode for preview.
config.default.spreadMode.description: The default spread mode for preview.
config.default.textLayer.description: Enable selectable text layer over the PDF. `enablePermissions` honors the PDF's copy-permission flag.
config.default.annotations.description: Render PDF annotations (links, forms, etc.). `enableStorage` keeps in-session annotation edits.
config.default.annotationEditor.descript: Annotation editor mode loaded by default.
config.default.externalLinkTarget.descri: How external links inside the PDF are opened.
config.theme.description: Page color theme. `dark` forces dark background/foreground via PDF.js page colors.
config.enableScripting.description: Allow execution of JavaScript embedded in PDFs. Disabled by default for security.
config.enablePermissions.description: Respect the PDF document's permission flags. When enabled (default), the viewer disables actions the PDF prohibits (copy, modify, annotate). Disable to bypass these restrictions — for example when working with your own PDFs that have outdated permission flags.
config.enableHWA.description: Use hardware acceleration for canvas rendering.
config.maxCanvasPixels.description: Maximum canvas pixels per page. Lower this for very large PDFs that exceed GPU limits. Set to `-1` for no limit.
config.toolbarDensity.description: Density of the PDF viewer toolbar. `compact` shrinks paddings for small windows; `touch` enlarges hit targets for touch screens.
config.theme.auto: Follow the VS Code color theme.
config.theme.light: Always use a light page theme.
config.theme.dark: Always use a dark page theme.
config.toolbarDensity.touch: Enlarged hit targets for touch screens.
config.default.cursor.hand: Hand (pan) tool for dragging the page.
config.default.scrollMode.page: Show one page at a time.
config.default.textLayer.enablePermissio: Enable, honoring the PDF's copy-permission flag.
